task.title: Traverse an employee hierarchy
task.statement: Using a recursive CTE, return every employee_id and employee_name from the organization. Return rows ordered by employee_id.
expected_evidence: Use an anchor query and a recursive member to traverse manager relationships.

private.reference_sql: WITH RECURSIVE org AS (SELECT employee_id, manager_id, employee_name FROM employees WHERE manager_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.employee_id, e.manager_id, e.employee_name FROM employees e JOIN org o ON e.manager_id = o.employee_id) SELECT employee_id, employee_name FROM org ORDER BY employee_id
hints: A recursive CTE has an anchor member and a recursive member.
Start with employees who have no manager, then join direct reports.
Name the CTE org and repeatedly join employees.manager_id to the prior employee_id.
private.solution_explanation: The anchor selects the root employee and the recursive member follows manager relationships until every reachable employee is included.
